  Plain-language policy · updated 28 August 2026PrivacyThis service stores only what a small business needs to manage an appointment.What is storedYour name, email, optional phone number, requested time, consent timestamp, booking state, and reminder checklist state. The service also stores a daily page-view count with no cookie, fingerprint, or IP address attached.Why and for how longThe data exists to request, approve, confirm, change, and remember an appointment. On the free plan, closed booking records are deleted 30 days after the appointment. Panel Pro retains closed records for up to 365 days. Active future bookings remain until closed.Who can see itThe business owner can see booking details. Anyone who has your unguessable private booking link can view and change that booking, so keep it private. We do not sell data or use it for advertising.Deletion and correctionUse the private link to cancel, or contact the business shown on your booking page to request early deletion or correction. Hosting and checkout infrastructure may process network and transaction data under Sociobot/Dodo policies.Local storageThe owner session is kept only for the browser tab session. A purchased license and its last verification result are stored locally in the owner’s browser so the free experience never waits on billing.Clear appointment state, no guest account. Original generated artwork; no tracking cookies.PrivacyTerms
